svg.title: adnan.log
svg.desc: A sheet of green-bar printer paper. Hi, I'm Adnan: AI engineer & full-stack developer, building LLM systems that show their work. MSc CS & Software Engineering @ Constructor University Bremen. From Chennai. Log: 2025 2 papers: real-time vision chatbot, RL traffic-signal control; 2025 began freelancing: e-shop, quotation SaaS, architecture PM tool; 2026-02 shipped LLM pipelines on AWS as a Forward Deployed AI Engineer; 2026-05 graduated B.Tech in AI & Data Science, CGPA 8.36/10; 2026-09 moved MAA -> BRE, started MSc at Constructor University Bremen; 2026-10 won the SereneDB challenge at the schubKI National AI Hackathon; now open to Werkstudent roles in AI/ML, full-stack, data or cloud.
